name: publication_audit_events
description: Append-only record of publications and restores, with the acting member and the branches each program concerns.
lifecycle: Inserted in the same transaction as the publication it records; never updated or deleted at runtime. Retention follows the company (provisional until PH-13).

columns.Meaning: Program the event concerns; not a foreign key, so events outlive deleted programs.
Branches the program concerns, for branch-scoped audit reads; empty for a whole-company group.
columns.Null meaning: Never null; an empty array means the program is company-wide.

columns.Meaning: Membership through which the publication was made.
Bounded summary: source kind, generation, counts and IDs; never manifest content.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (actor_principal_id) REFERENCES principals(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The actor is a known principal.
The branch list is present and bounded.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, actor_membership_id) REFERENCES memberships(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The acting membership belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id) REFERENCES companies(id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: An event belongs to an existing company.
Subjects come from a closed set.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publication_audit_events_company_id_id_key ON public.publication_audit_events USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX publication_audit_events_subject_idx ON public.publication_audit_events USING btree (company_id, subject_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Reads a program's publication history newest first.
